mentions.name: NPC/Item/Attack game interaction system
mentions.description: A past, abandoned attempt at building a game system similar to Easel, structured around NPC, Item, and Attack classes with a corresponding NPC Manager, Item Manager, and Attack Manager that calculated all their interactions and states each cycle.
mentions.problem: Handling interactions between different game elements — declaring which objects were affected by attacks or were player/NPC interactive, plus inheritance and whether objects or a manager should perform calculations — became deeply tangled and a fresh reset would have been better.
mentions.source_excerpt: I ended up having NPC, Item, Attack classes and for each a NPC Manager, Item Manager, and Attack Manager to calculate all their interactions and states.

evidence.value: I ended up having NPC, Item, Attack classes and for each a NPC Manager, Item Manager, and Attack Manager to calculate all their interactions and states.
